findings.summary: The Fish script splits command substitution output by newline, so the new three-line type/value/help format is parsed one line at a time, breaking Fish completion for every item.

Escaped newlines (backslash-n) in help and value are never converted back because Fish echo doesn't interpret escapes without -e, so multi-line help shows literal \n and values containing newlines complete wrongly (also for dir/file items).
test_fish_multiline_help_complete only checks exit_code and Python output, doesn't exercise the Fish script, and would pass even if the for...else loop never hit the --at item.
`help_ = item.help or "_"` makes a real help string of "_" indistinguishable from no help.
Docstring says versionchanged 8.3 but the changelog entry is under Unreleased after 8.3.3, so the version is inconsistent.
